name: Pulse — Your X Concierge
description: Samples your X timeline at intervals during the day without posting or interacting, then groups the notable material into a single brief that lands at 7am. For people who want to stop scrolling but still keep track; it reads only, so it will not reply or repost on your behalf.

official.title: Pulse by Andrej
official.description: A read-only X concierge. Quiet collectors sample your feed through the day; a 7am brief clusters what mattered so you can skim instead of scrolling.
